title: Herald (Drake Interplanetary, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Herald is a small, fast data runner from Drake Interplanetary in Star Citizen for one or two people. Its two-seat cockpit sits around a large central engine and an encrypted computer core. It uses the common controls without changes.

panels.name: Herald: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Herald's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (three)
controls.text: The Herald has three guns that the pilot fires. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (18 missiles)
controls.text: The Herald carries 18 missiles. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

controls.name: Data storage
controls.text: The Herald carries data in an encrypted computer, which makes it a courier for information.
controls.context: Its big engine is there to carry that information away fast.
